maddeler.e:
نسترئل (form X)
# نَسْتَرْئِلُ (nastarʔilu) /nas.tar.ʔi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَرْأَلَ (istarʔala)
# نَسْتَرْئِلَ (nastarʔila) /nas.tar.ʔi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَرْأَلَ (istarʔala)
# نَسْتَرْئِلْ (nastarʔil) /nas.tar.ʔil/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَرْأَلَ (istarʔala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
